info.name: SevenRooms AKIC — RAW + ANALYTICS (GET only)
info.description:
US production https://api.sevenrooms.com/2_4.

**Write operations are not in this collection.** The only POST is `/auth` (login). Everything else is GET.

How to use:
1. Select environment **SevenRooms AKIC (local)**.
2. Run **0 Auth**.
3. **1 RAW** — Body tab = full vendor JSON (schema work). Do not email reservation/client bodies.
4. **2 ANALYTICS** — same GET, open **Visualize**. That table is the keep-list for Gold (covers, status, shift, spend, POS tickets). Guest PII is stripped from Visualize.
5. **3 PROBES** — 200/401/404 is the answer. Clients probe is PII; do not share.

After RAW venues, `venue_id` is set from the first site for charges.
